title: Ensure build workers are single-used
description: A worker reused across builds carries the previous build's workspace, caches and any implants a malicious build left behind. Whether agents are ephemeral is a property of how they are provisioned — a cloud plugin, Kubernetes pods, static VMs — which the node list does not reveal.
remediation: Provision agents so each build starts clean — configure a cloud at Manage Jenkins -> Clouds: one-shot containers or pods (the kubernetes plugin's default), cloud agents with a low retention, or VM images reset between builds. Static agents that persist for months are the shape to move away from; where they must stay, wipe workspaces between builds and treat them as long-lived credential holders.
fixSummary: Provision one-shot agents at Manage Jenkins -> Clouds (containers, pods, reset VMs).
